mkdir -p /tmp && ( nohup bash -lc 'python3 << '"'"'EOF'"'"'
from datasets import load_dataset
from transformers import AutoTokenizer

tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct")
ds = load_dataset('"'"'ryanmarten/OpenThoughts-1k-sample'"'"', name='"'"'metadata'"'"', split='"'"'train'"'"')

science_domains = ['"'"'physics'"'"', '"'"'chemistry'"'"', '"'"'biology'"'"']
science_data = ds.filter(lambda x: x['"'"'domain'"'"'] in science_domains)

print(f"Science examples: {len(science_data)}")
print(f"Science domains: {set(science_data['"'"'domain'"'"'])}")

# Summary
for domain in sorted(set(science_data['"'"'domain'"'"'])):
    domain_data = [ex for ex in science_data if ex['"'"'domain'"'"'] == domain]
    total_reasoning = 0
    total_solution = 0
    for ex in domain_data:
        if ex.get('"'"'deepseek_reasoning'"'"'):
            total_reasoning += len(tokenizer.encode(ex['"'"'deepseek_reasoning'"'"']))
        if ex.get('"'"'deepseek_solution'"'"'):
            total_solution += len(tokenizer.encode(ex['"'"'deepseek_solution'"'"']))
    print(f"{domain}: reasoning={total_reasoning}, solution={total_solution}, total={total_reasoning+total_solution}")
